nodes.description: Owned.owner: address of the current contract owner, set to msg.sender in the Owned constructor.
Owned.newOwner: pending owner address set by transferOwnership, cleared in acceptOwnership.
DwayneToken.symbol public string token symbol, set to DWYN in the constructor.
DwayneToken.name public string token name, set to DWAYNE in the constructor.
DwayneToken.decimals public uint8, set to 18 in the constructor.
DwayneToken._totalSupply public uint holding the fixed total token supply.
balances mapping(address => uint) tracking token balances, mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
allowed mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) ERC20 allowance store, mutated by approve and approveAndCall.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b): checked addition with overflow require(c >= a).
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b): checked subtraction with underflow require(b <= a).
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b): checked multiplication with require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b): division guarded by require(b > 0).
Owned.transferOwnership(address _newOwner) protected by onlyOwner, sets pending newOwner.
Owned.acceptOwnership(): requires msg.sender == newOwner, transfers ownership and resets newOwner.
DwayneToken constructor: initializes metadata, total supply and pre-mints all tokens to a fixed address.
DwayneToken.totalSupply() constant: returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
DwayneToken.balanceOf(address tokenOwner) constant: returns the recorded balance.
DwayneToken.transfer(address to, uint tokens): moves tokens between balances using safeSub/safeAdd.
DwayneToken.approve(address spender, uint tokens): sets allowance for msg.sender and emits Approval.
DwayneToken.transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): spends allowance and moves balances.
DwayneToken.allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) constant: returns remaining allowance.
DwayneToken.approveAndCall: sets allowance then performs an external call to spender.receiveApproval.
DwayneToken payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts.
DwayneToken.transferAnyERC20Token: onlyOwner external call to an arbitrary ERC20 token's transfer.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, balances and allowances.
External call to attacker-controlled spender contract receiveApproval after allowance update, reentrancy vector.
External call to an arbitrary tokenAddress contract transfer, reentrancy/arbitrary-call vector.
Arithmetic mutation of balances/allowances via safeAdd/safeSub inside transfer and transferFrom.
